T Natarajan returns to Sunrisers Hyderabad in IPL 2027 trade

In the first trade for IPL 2027, T Natarajan has returned to Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH). He was previously with Delhi Capitals (DC). Reports indicate a financial loss for Natarajan in the trade, with one outlet stating he returned to SRH for ₹5 crore after being valued at ₹10 crore, and another mentioning a loss of ₹5.75 crore. Delhi Capitals included Zeeshan Ansari in the deal.
